lead.tldr: Bitcoin down 22% in Q1 2026 marking worst performance since 2018 amid orderly deleveraging. • Grayscale files for spot AAVE ETF signaling institutional DeFi adoption momentum. • Animoca Brands gains Dubai VASP license enabling regulated services for global investors. • Mirae Asset acquires 92% of Korbit for $92M highlighting traditional finance crypto entry. • Bitcoin OG transfers $543M ETH raising Ethereum sell-off risks for short-term traders. • Russians spend $648M daily on crypto prompting imminent regulatory vote in spring.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Heads For Worst Quarter Since 2018 With 22% Drop
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin has declined approximately 22% year-to-date in Q1 2026, trading near $68,670 after opening the year at $87,700, potentially marking the worst quarterly performance since 2018. Despite the sharp pullback, institutional investors remain selectively constructive, with survey data showing that 70% of institutional respondents view Bitcoin as undervalued and nearly half would buy additional positions if prices dropped further. The decline reflects broader macro headwinds and liquidity concerns rather than a structural breakdown, as institutional positioning has shifted toward defensive options strategies and large-cap exposure amid geopolitical uncertainty. Market observers note that while Q1 volatility is historically common in crypto markets, the underlying institutional adoption and halving-cycle dynamics could support a potential recovery later in 2026.

top_signals.title: Grayscale files spot AAVE ETF – Sparks institutional shift narrative
top_signals.summary: Grayscale has filed for a spot AAVE ETF, suggesting potential institutional interest in the DeFi protocol. AAVE's price is rebounding amid this news and renewed interest from derivatives markets.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin needs a quantum upgrade. So why isn’t it happening?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the urgent need for Bitcoin to adopt post-quantum cryptography to mitigate risks associated with the development of quantum computers. It highlights the potential disastrous consequences of upgrading too early or too late.

top_signals.title: Animoca Brands secures Dubai VASP license to provide broker-dealer and investment services
top_signals.summary: Animoca Brands has secured a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) license in Dubai. This license enables the company to offer regulated virtual asset services to global institutional and qualified investors in and from Dubai.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s biggest securities firm snaps up crypto exchange as stock market soars
top_signals.summary: South Korea's largest securities firm, Mirae Asset, is acquiring a 92% stake in the crypto exchange Korbit for $92 million. This acquisition occurs amidst a booming stock market in South Korea.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin OG moves $543 mln in ETH – Is a major Ethereum sell-off about to begin?
top_signals.summary: A Bitcoin OG moved $543 million worth of ETH, raising concerns about a potential major sell-off in the Ethereum market. The article speculates on the investor's intentions and the potential impact on Ethereum's price.

top_signals.title: Grayscale Files With SEC to Convert Aave Trust Into ETF
top_signals.summary: Grayscale has filed with the SEC to convert its Aave trust into an ETF, named the Grayscale Aave Trust ETF. The proposed ETF would trade on NYSE Arca under the ticker symbol "GAVE."

top_signals.title: Kevin O’Leary Wins $2.8M Defamation Suit Against ‘Bitboy’
top_signals.summary: Kevin O'Leary won a $2.8 million defamation suit against crypto influencer Ben Armstrong, known as 'Bitboy'. The suit was related to X posts accusing O'Leary of murder.

top_signals.title: Ethereum’s bearish positioning deepens: Is strategic whale rotation why?
top_signals.summary: Ethereum's market positioning appears bearish due to Binance inflows, but shrinking reserves suggest strategic repositioning by whales. The article analyzes potential reasons behind this market behavior.

top_signals.title: Why experienced investors are quietly betting on altcoins in 2026
top_signals.summary: The article suggests that experienced investors are quietly investing in altcoins in anticipation of a future bull market around 2026. The premise is based on the historical pattern that significant crypto moves often begin when the market appears stagnant.

top_signals.title: Russians spending $648 million on crypto every day, says finance ministry
top_signals.summary: The Russian Finance Ministry reports that Russians are spending $648 million on crypto daily, totaling $130 billion annually. Lawmakers are set to vote on crypto regulations in the spring session, and the Moscow Exchange aims to participate in the crypto market.
